newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KLM, Alitalia in firm alliance talks-paper.
newsitem.headline: KLM, Alitalia in firm alliance talks-paper.

text.p: Dutch carrier KLM and Italian airline Alitalia are firming up talks on a possible alliance, KLM's outgoing president Pieter Bouw told a Dutch newspaper in an interview on Friday.

"They are not yet specific negotiations on a firm alliance, but we have been talking to the Italians for around a year and a half or so and things are starting to become more concrete," daily NRC Handelsblad quoted Bouw as saying.
KLM was not immediately available for comment.
Speculation on a possible KLM-Alitalia tie-up has mounted with British Airways.
Alitalia's state-run holding company Iri said earlier this week the airline was seeking an international alliance by the end of the year and named KLM as the prime contender.
The Dutch carrier announced on Wednesday it was selling its 19 percent shareholding in U.S. partner Northwest in exchange for long-term operating contracts of at least 10 years.
Alitalia is also said to be Northwest's preferred partner due to its strong position in Latin America. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
